name: hypertask_comments
does: List, add, edit, delete, pin or star ticket comments. Untyped agent notes stay hidden, including replies and mentions. Files require kind. Use question for decisions, qa for verdicts, or done for summaries. People comments use short plain sentences; technical details and status belong in the agent log.
use_when: Use to discuss a ticket or inspect its conversation; list with include_activity also retrieves work history, and pin keeps one answer at the top.
do_not_use_when: Do not use for ticket descriptions or unpublished drafts; use hypertask_tasks or hypertask_drafts instead.
parameters_and_caveats: action selects an operation; input contains only that operation’s documented fields. response_format defaults to concise for reads; detailed retains full fields. limit defaults to 20 (maximum 50) and offset defaults to 0 for bounded read results; use returned pagination or narrower filters. text is HTML unless content_type=markdown; comment_id is required to edit, delete, pin or star, and ticket identifiers locate list/add targets. A star is the caller’s own private marker. Ownership and board membership still apply.
